A must-see! A stunning fully frescoed renaissance church. Most of the paintings are the work of Bernardino Luini.
Porta del Castello Visconteo detta la Ghirlanda

"See who's in charge!" The round corner towers of the castle are two fists smacked down on the city plains, while the central square tower stares balefully down towards city centre. Who'd dare challenge the Duke? Yet so confident is he,…

The triumphal arch of peace stands at the place at one of Milan's seven city gates. First the gate was known as Porta Giovia and was closer to the city center. Porta Sempione means "Gate towards Simplon", and once the road leading over…
The tower is 108 m high built in 1933 and designed by architect Giò Ponti. From here you can get good views over Milan.

Leonardo da Vinci Museum of Science and Technology
